author: NASS
description:
Step back into 1920s China and experience everyday life through rare historical footage, meticulously restored and colorized in UHD 60fps. Travel through bustling streets filled with rickshaws, traditional markets, ancient city walls, rivers, wooden pavilions, and colonial-era architecture, capturing a fascinating moment in China's rich history.

📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to 4K
• Manual color corrections 
• Classical restoration workflows (AviSynth ) combined with modern tools for (60fps, stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring )
• Sound design created for immersive atmosphere

Please, be aware that colorization colors are not real and fake, colorization was made only for the ambiance and do not represent real historica
title: China 1920s: Street Life | Advanced Colorization & Restoration (UHD 60fps)
